lines.text: GraphReFly is a synchronous reactive graph runtime for TypeScript. You compose
nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep
async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries.
The graph can also describe itself:
- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary.
- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams.
- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values.
- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime.
The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,
and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge
boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages.
import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from "@graphrefly/ts/operators";
The package also exports the common surface from the root:
import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from "@graphrefly/ts";
Start with the task you need to perform. These layers are not a required learning
sequence, and user experience levels do not select different runtime semantics.
| Compose an application and inspect its graph | `@graphrefly/ts/graph` or the root | Named nodes, explicit dependencies, composition and inspection |
| Implement a node or runtime integration | `@graphrefly/ts/core` | Low-level Node, Ctx, batch, protocol and dispatcher contracts |
| Represent business results and issues | `@graphrefly/ts/data` | Passive `DataResult<T>` and `DataIssue` payloads; no protocol ERROR or lifecycle behavior |
| Reuse a horizontal graph pattern | `@graphrefly/ts/patterns` | Existing patterns such as `admissionHandoff` and `eventFlow` |
| Use a domain solution | An existing focused `@graphrefly/ts/solutions/*` entry | The selected domain's inputs, policies and lifecycle contract |
| Connect existing values to a UI | `@graphrefly/ts/adapters` or a framework package | Observation and framework integration under the adapter's documented semantics |
A domain-specific solution need not apply to every business. Its supported inputs

[{"ok":true,"path":"packages/ts/README.md","sha256":"16b4f3468b1260617e54032228ca2992964643ad176d28040f968d355e1e3533","totalLines":384,"startLine":1,"endLine":80,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"# @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":2,"text":""},{"line":3,"text":"GraphReFly is a synchronous reactive graph runtime for TypeScript. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. These layers are not a required learning"},{"line":69,"text":"sequence, and user experience levels do not select different runtime semantics."},{"line":70,"text":""},{"line":71,"text":"| Task | Entry | Responsibility |"},{"line":72,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":73,"text":"| Compose an application and inspect its graph | `@graphrefly/ts/graph` or the root | Named nodes, explicit dependencies, composition and inspection |"},{"line":74,"text":"| Implement a node or runtime integration | `@graphrefly/ts/core` | Low-level Node, Ctx, batch, protocol and dispatcher contracts |"},{"line":75,"text":"| Represent business results and issues | `@graphrefly/ts/data` | Passive `DataResult<T>` and `DataIssue` payloads; no protocol ERROR or lifecycle behavior |"},{"line":76,"text":"| Reuse a horizontal graph pattern | `@graphrefly/ts/patterns` | Existing patterns such as `admissionHandoff` and `eventFlow` |"},{"line":77,"text":"| Use a domain solution | An existing focused `@graphrefly/ts/solutions/*` entry | The selected domain's inputs, policies and lifecycle contract |"},{"line":78,"text":"| Connect existing values to a UI | `@graphrefly/ts/adapters` or a framework package | Observation and framework integration under the adapter's documented semantics |"},{"line":79,"text":""},{"line":80,"text":"A domain-specific solution need not apply to every business. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. [{"ok":true,"path":"packages/ts/README.md","sha256":"16b4f3468b1260617e54032228ca2992964643ad176d28040f968d355e1e3533","totalLines":384,"startLine":1,"endLine":80,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"# @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":2,"text":""},{"line":3,"text":"GraphReFly is a synchronous reactive graph runtime for TypeScript. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. [{"ok":true,"path":"packages/ts/README.md","sha256":"16b4f3468b1260617e54032228ca2992964643ad176d28040f968d355e1e3533","totalLines":384,"startLine":1,"endLine":80,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"# @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":2,"text":""},{"line":3,"text":"GraphReFly is a synchronous reactive graph runtime for TypeScript. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. lines.text: GraphReFly is a synchronous reactive graph runtime for TypeScript. You compose
nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep
async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries.
The graph can also describe itself:
- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary.
- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams.
- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values.
- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime.
The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,
and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge
boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages.
import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from "@graphrefly/ts/operators";
The package also exports the common surface from the root:
import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from "@graphrefly/ts";
Start with the task you need to perform. These layers are not a required learning
sequence, and user experience levels do not select different runtime semantics.
| Compose an application and inspect its graph | `@graphrefly/ts/graph` or the root | Named nodes, explicit dependencies, composition and inspection |
| Implement a node or runtime integration | `@graphrefly/ts/core` | Low-level Node, Ctx, batch, protocol and dispatcher contracts |
| Represent business results and issues | `@graphrefly/ts/data` | Passive `DataResult<T>` and `DataIssue` payloads; no protocol ERROR or lifecycle behavior |
| Reuse a horizontal graph pattern | `@graphrefly/ts/patterns` | Existing patterns such as `admissionHandoff` and `eventFlow` |
| Use a domain solution | An existing focused `@graphrefly/ts/solutions/*` entry | The selected domain's inputs, policies and lifecycle contract |
| Connect existing values to a UI | `@graphrefly/ts/adapters` or a framework package | Observation and framework integration under the adapter's documented semantics |

You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. These layers are not a required learning"},{"line":69,"text":"sequence, and user experience levels do not select different runtime semantics."},{"line":70,"text":""},{"line":71,"text":"| Task | Entry | Responsibility |"},{"line":72,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":73,"text":"| Compose an application and inspect its graph | `@graphrefly/ts/graph` or the root | Named nodes, explicit dependencies, composition and inspection |"},{"line":74,"text":"| Implement a node or runtime integration | `@graphrefly/ts/core` | Low-level Node, Ctx, batch, protocol and dispatcher contracts |"},{"line":75,"text":"| Represent business results and issues | `@graphrefly/ts/data` | Passive `DataResult<T>` and `DataIssue` payloads; no protocol ERROR or lifecycle behavior |"},{"line":76,"text":"| Reuse a horizontal graph pattern | `@graphrefly/ts/patterns` | Existing patterns such as `admissionHandoff` and `eventFlow` |"},{"line":77,"text":"| Use a domain solution | An existing focused `@graphrefly/ts/solutions/*` entry | The selected domain's inputs, policies and lifecycle contract |"},{"line":78,"text":"| Connect existing values to a UI | `@graphrefly/ts/adapters` or a framework package | Observation and framework integration under the adapter's documented semantics |"},{"line":79,"text":""},{"line":80,"text":"A domain-specific solution need not apply to every business. [{"ok":true,"path":"packages/ts/README.md","sha256":"16b4f3468b1260617e54032228ca2992964643ad176d28040f968d355e1e3533","totalLines":384,"startLine":1,"endLine":80,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"# @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":2,"text":""},{"line":3,"text":"GraphReFly is a synchronous reactive graph runtime for TypeScript. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. These layers are not a required learning"},{"line":69,"text":"sequence, and user experience levels do not select different runtime semantics."},{"line":70,"text":""},{"line":71,"text":"| Task | Entry | Responsibility |"},{"line":72,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":73,"text":"| Compose an application and inspect its graph | `@graphrefly/ts/graph` or the root | Named nodes, explicit dependencies, composition and inspection |"},{"line":74,"text":"| Implement a node or runtime integration | `@graphrefly/ts/core` | Low-level Node, Ctx, batch, protocol and dispatcher contracts |"},{"line":75,"text":"| Represent business results and issues | `@graphrefly/ts/data` | Passive `DataResult<T>` and `DataIssue` payloads; no protocol ERROR or lifecycle behavior |"},{"line":76,"text":"| Reuse a horizontal graph pattern | `@graphrefly/ts/patterns` | Existing patterns such as `admissionHandoff` and `eventFlow` |"},{"line":77,"text":"| Use a domain solution | An existing focused `@graphrefly/ts/solutions/*` entry | The selected domain's inputs, policies and lifecycle contract |"},{"line":78,"text":"| Connect existing values to a UI | `@graphrefly/ts/adapters` or a framework package | Observation and framework integration under the adapter's documented semantics |"},{"line":79,"text":""},{"line":80,"text":"A domain-specific solution need not apply to every business. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. * the body runs ONCE on activation (node `_activate`), schedules its work, and emits later via
* the captured `ctx.down` (an external tier-3 emit → the leading DIRTY is synthesized for it,

* `Promise` / `for await` are confined to source bodies; the wave core stays sync. Cleanup is

* bare scalar. The universal coercion target for higher-order operators (CSP-2.7).

You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. [{"ok":true,"path":"packages/ts/README.md","sha256":"16b4f3468b1260617e54032228ca2992964643ad176d28040f968d355e1e3533","totalLines":384,"startLine":1,"endLine":80,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"# @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":2,"text":""},{"line":3,"text":"GraphReFly is a synchronous reactive graph runtime for TypeScript. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. [{"ok":true,"path":"packages/ts/README.md","sha256":"16b4f3468b1260617e54032228ca2992964643ad176d28040f968d355e1e3533","totalLines":384,"startLine":1,"endLine":80,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"# @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":2,"text":""},{"line":3,"text":"GraphReFly is a synchronous reactive graph runtime for TypeScript. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. [{"ok":true,"path":"packages/ts/README.md","sha256":"16b4f3468b1260617e54032228ca2992964643ad176d28040f968d355e1e3533","totalLines":384,"startLine":1,"endLine":80,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"# @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":2,"text":""},{"line":3,"text":"GraphReFly is a synchronous reactive graph runtime for TypeScript. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages."},{"line":48,"text":""},{"line":49,"text":"## Common Imports"},{"line":50,"text":""},{"line":51,"text":"```ts"},{"line":52,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts/graph\";"},{"line":53,"text":"import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from \"@graphrefly/ts/operators\";"},{"line":54,"text":"import { fromPromise, fromEvent, timer } from \"@graphrefly/ts/sources\";"},{"line":55,"text":"import { memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts/storage\";"},{"line":56,"text":"import { describeToMermaid } from \"@graphrefly/ts/render\";"},{"line":57,"text":"import type { DataIssue, DataResult } from \"@graphrefly/ts/data\";"},{"line":58,"text":"```"},{"line":59,"text":""},{"line":60,"text":"The package also exports the common surface from the root:"},{"line":61,"text":""},{"line":62,"text":"```ts"},{"line":63,"text":"import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":64,"text":"```"},{"line":65,"text":""},{"line":66,"text":"## Choose an entry by task"},{"line":67,"text":""},{"line":68,"text":"Start with the task you need to perform. 1) Source creation. `graph.initNode(fromPushNotification<number>(register), [], { name: "pushNumbers" })` is the graph-bound operator/source funnel (packages/ts/src/graph/graph.ts:513-543, esp. 528-542); it delegates to the free initNode (packages/ts/src/graph/operators.ts:185-191, 204-222) and records the real factory name in the inspection index. fromPushNotification is a published source factory: packages/ts/src/graph/sources.ts:1210-1229, exported from @graphrefly/ts/sources (packages/ts/src/sources/index.ts:32) and the root (packages/ts/src/index.ts:373). It accepts PushRegister<T> = (deliver) => PushUnsubscribe | undefined (sources.ts:290-292) and returns Operator<never, T>, so the node is Node<number> and no deps are needed (a source is a depless operator; graph.ts:523-526).

2) When registration activates. The factory body runs ONCE on activation (sources.ts:4-9, 58-84): the source spec's setup is invoked by the node's activation path, and only then is `register(deliver)` called (sources.ts:1216-1221). Activation is subscriber-driven: Node.subscribe adds the sink, then calls _activate if not yet activated (packages/ts/src/node/node.ts:417-465, esp. 440-460). So `register` is not called at connectPushNumbers time; it runs when the first subscriber attaches — here our own forwarding subscription, or a caller subscription that happens first. Because register may deliver synchronously while registering, the factory's `deliver` closure is already installed and forwards via ctx.down([["DATA", payload]]) (sources.ts:1218-1220); those synchronous values are delivered as DATA waves and reach our sink, so 0 is forwarded like any other number. Protocol messages are filtered by the `msg[0] === "DATA"` guard: the closed message set includes START/DIRTY/RESOLVED/INVALIDATE/COMPLETE/ERROR/TEARDOWN/PAUSE/RESUME/PULL (packages/ts/src/protocol/messages.ts:21-32), and only DATA carries a value (messages.ts:24).

3) Cleanup semantics. The factory registers its teardown through ctx.onDeactivation (sources.ts:75-81): on deactivation it sets `done = true` (so late pushes are dropped) and calls the host's unsubscribe if register returned one (sources.ts:1222-1225). Deactivation happens when the node's subscriber set becomes empty: Node.subscribe's unsubscribe deletes the sink and calls _deactivate only when subscribers.size === 0 (node.ts:441-444), and nodeDeactivate runs the onDeactivation hooks (packages/ts/src/node/node-lifecycle-runtime.ts:76-83). Therefore: if another subscriber still remains (e.g. the caller later subscribed separately to `source`), our stop() removes only our sink, the subscriber set is non-empty, the node stays active, and the host registration cleanup is NOT run — the transport keeps delivering to the remaining subscriber. If ours was the last subscriber, the set becomes empty, the node deactivates, and the factory's cleanup runs: `done` flips and the host unsubscribe (when provided) is invoked, detaching the host listener.

4) Why stop is not a transport/Graph shutdown. stop() is idempotent (a `stopped` flag guards the single detach) and only calls the unsubscribe handle returned by our own subscribe (node.ts:417-419, 441-444). It detaches this function's own subscription; it does not call register, does not create another Graph, and does not open/close any connection. The factory's own contract says the host owns network/native setup and the factory owns reactive delivery and teardown only (sources.ts:1199-1204), and cleanup is best-effort deactivation, not a global shutdown. The caller-owned Graph and transport may have other subscribers, other nodes, or other registrations; stop cannot promise to shut them down, and the caller may later subscribe separately to `source` (which would re-activate it and re-run register).

5) Scope/authority. Only published entrypoints are used: @graphrefly/ts/sources for fromPushNotification and PushRegister, @graphrefly/ts/graph for Graph, @graphrefly/ts/core for Node. No source-relative imports, no invented modules, no direct register call, no extra Graph, no connection management. Caller callbacks are assumed not to throw. function.name: broker
function.description: Read entry/task.json first. Search frozen sources with literal text (rg -F semantics), then read original paths and 1-based inclusive line ranges. Search is line-based, ordered by path then line; offset paginates matches. Empty pathPrefix searches all supplied sources. Search snippets may be truncated; use read for full lines. Read with path alone for the first bounded page. Optional startLine/endLine (or null defaults) select a range; the controller caps all results at 80 lines and 12000 bytes. Continue at nextLine. Recoverable argument errors return ok:false; correct them within the same session budgets. No shell, filesystem or external MCP access. When ready, call prepare_submit alone to switch irreversibly to the reserved submission stage, then submit code with broker. Both calls count toward the original budgets. Direct submit still uses the current response cap.

lines.text: GraphReFly is a synchronous reactive graph runtime for TypeScript. You compose
nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep
async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries.
The graph can also describe itself:
- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary.
- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams.
- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values.
- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime.
The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,
and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge
boundaries. Results re-enter the graph as facts, commands, or messages.
import { map, filter, scan, switchMap } from "@graphrefly/ts/operators";
The package also exports the common surface from the root:
import { graph, map, timer, memoryKv } from "@graphrefly/ts";
Start with the task you need to perform. These layers are not a required learning
sequence, and user experience levels do not select different runtime semantics.
| Compose an application and inspect its graph | `@graphrefly/ts/graph` or the root | Named nodes, explicit dependencies, composition and inspection |
| Implement a node or runtime integration | `@graphrefly/ts/core` | Low-level Node, Ctx, batch, protocol and dispatcher contracts |
| Represent business results and issues | `@graphrefly/ts/data` | Passive `DataResult<T>` and `DataIssue` payloads; no protocol ERROR or lifecycle behavior |
| Reuse a horizontal graph pattern | `@graphrefly/ts/patterns` | Existing patterns such as `admissionHandoff` and `eventFlow` |
| Use a domain solution | An existing focused `@graphrefly/ts/solutions/*` entry | The selected domain's inputs, policies and lifecycle contract |
| Connect existing values to a UI | `@graphrefly/ts/adapters` or a framework package | Observation and framework integration under the adapter's documented semantics |

[{"ok":true,"path":"packages/ts/README.md","sha256":"16b4f3468b1260617e54032228ca2992964643ad176d28040f968d355e1e3533","totalLines":384,"startLine":1,"endLine":80,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"# @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":2,"text":""},{"line":3,"text":"GraphReFly is a synchronous reactive graph runtime for TypeScript. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries. [{"ok":true,"path":"packages/ts/README.md","sha256":"16b4f3468b1260617e54032228ca2992964643ad176d28040f968d355e1e3533","totalLines":384,"startLine":1,"endLine":80,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"# @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":2,"text":""},{"line":3,"text":"GraphReFly is a synchronous reactive graph runtime for TypeScript. You compose"},{"line":4,"text":"nodes, push data through explicit messages, inspect the live graph, and keep"},{"line":5,"text":"async work at clear source/adapter/executor boundaries."},{"line":6,"text":""},{"line":7,"text":"```bash"},{"line":8,"text":"npm install @graphrefly/ts"},{"line":9,"text":"```"},{"line":10,"text":""},{"line":11,"text":"## Quick Start"},{"line":12,"text":""},{"line":13,"text":"```ts"},{"line":14,"text":"import { graph } from \"@graphrefly/ts\";"},{"line":15,"text":""},{"line":16,"text":"const g = graph({ name: \"example\" });"},{"line":17,"text":""},{"line":18,"text":"const count = g.state(0, { name: \"count\" });"},{"line":19,"text":"const doubled = g.derived([count], (n) => n * 2, { name: \"doubled\" });"},{"line":20,"text":""},{"line":21,"text":"doubled.subscribe((msg) => {"},{"line":22,"text":"  if (msg[0] === \"DATA\") console.log(\"doubled\", msg[1]);"},{"line":23,"text":"});"},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"count.set(3);"},{"line":26,"text":"```"},{"line":27,"text":""},{"line":28,"text":"The graph can also describe itself:"},{"line":29,"text":""},{"line":30,"text":"```ts"},{"line":31,"text":"console.log(g.topology());"},{"line":32,"text":"console.log(g.describe());"},{"line":33,"text":"```"},{"line":34,"text":""},{"line":35,"text":"## Core Ideas"},{"line":36,"text":""},{"line":37,"text":"- `state` is the sanctioned external input boundary."},{"line":38,"text":"- `derived` computes from declared dependencies."},{"line":39,"text":"- `producer` and source factories create graph-visible input streams."},{"line":40,"text":"- `effect` performs side effects from graph-visible values."},{"line":41,"text":"- Operators are node factories, not a second runtime."},{"line":42,"text":"- `describe()`, `topology()`, `observe()`, and `profile()` are read-only"},{"line":43,"text":"  inspection surfaces."},{"line":44,"text":""},{"line":45,"text":"The wave core is synchronous. Promises, timers, fetches, subprocesses, workers,"},{"line":46,"text":"and remote bridges belong at source, adapter, executor, worker, or wire-bridge"},{"line":47,"text":"boundaries.
